name: prose-writing
description: Use for substantive explanations, comparisons, proposals, and multi-part answers in conversational chat; or when writing or substantially revising reader-facing prose outside the current conversation, including documentation, design documents, incident reports, pull request descriptions, commit messages, release notes, application copy, generated reports, and substantive documentation or implementation comments. Comment length does not determine whether this applies. Do not use for formatting-only edits, bare factual lookups, or trivial same-scale comments.
